beats.say: Grand Theft Auto VI launches on consoles this year.
Set for 19 November 2026, it fits into the calendar like squeezing a month's work into a week.
But the PC release date remains a mystery, leaving fans eager for more details.
This latest entry in the beloved series promises an expansive open world inspired by Florida.
Players will explore Leonida's fictional state, featuring the Miami-inspired Vice City.
With early development starting in 2018, fans have waited years for this epic adventure.
So, when will GTA 6 hit PC? The wait continues, keeping gamers on the edge of their seats.
Are you excited for the console release or waiting for the PC version?

facts: Grand Theft Auto VI launches on consoles on 19 November 2026.
The PC release date for Grand Theft Auto VI is still unknown.
Grand Theft Auto VI is the eighth main entry in the series.
Early development of Grand Theft Auto VI began after Red Dead Redemption 2's release in 2018.
